observation.visible_scene: A man with white hair, a long white beard, and round glasses, wearing a grey suit over a white shirt, holds a plain white mug by its handle in his right hand. To the left, a silver-and-black robotic arm with a two-finger gripper and a small camera-like head sits against a uniform grey studio backdrop. A sliver of a white object is visible at the bottom-right edge.
visible_changes: The man raises the mug from chest height toward his face; by roughly the middle of the excerpt the rim reaches his lips.
Once at his mouth he tilts the mug upward and holds it there, in a sipping posture, for the rest of the clip (the motion is already in progress at the start and continues past the end).
His gaze shifts from looking down at the mug to looking forward over its rim.

The framing progressively tightens: the man grows larger on the right and the robot arm is pushed toward the lower-left corner, indicating a slow camera zoom-in / dolly-in rather than movement of the arm.
The robot arm stays essentially stationary; a small green indicator light on its joint is intermittently visible.
The white object at the bottom right remains in place, only partially visible.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the man lowers the mug or completes the drink after the excerpt ends.
What the man is looking at or holding below the frame (the white object at the bottom right).
The purpose of the robot arm or whether it ever interacts with the man.
How the drinking motion began before the first sampled frame.
uncertain_details: The tightening of the frame could be camera zoom, the man leaning forward, or both; the featureless grey background gives no parallax to separate them.
The exact degree of mug tilt between the sipping frames is subtle and hard to quantify.
The on/off pattern of the robot's green joint light is not clearly resolved across frames.
